tb21_profile.skill: Recover a discrete board state from a rendered PNG (segment the grid, identify each piece by its glyph), then find every winning move for the side to move — normally by building a FEN and driving a chess engine — and emit it in an exact notation
tb21_profile.domain: Image-to-structured-data extraction (PIL/OpenCV, template matching) plus chess: FEN, UCI move notation, python-chess or Stockfish
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec with one exact answer written to a file; no starter code, the whole pipeline must be built

verifier_notes: Nothing misgraded that I checked. Worth flagging the opposite of the usual warning: Terminal-Lego's games-and-vision block is unusually well verified for that corpus — task_13538 (chess engine) is strong at 13/21 substantive, task_09056 (board-state detection) 13/19, task_14899 (image comparison) 22/36 — so those are real training signal, not the thin Keras-style entries elsewhere in that pool. Several CalibForge games tasks are graded 'ok' only because they ship one or two tests, but each of those tests pins the exact expected move or score (games_20260611_112034_001, games_20260606_172622_001, games_20260615_143956_001 are all 1.0 strength with a single pinned test); they are stronger than the grade label suggests.

notes: CalibForge has a whole `games` category that is almost purpose-built for this TB2.1 task: several entries are board-image-in, best-move-file-out with pinned answers, and others supply the Stockfish-driving half in chess itself. Nine of the final ten come from there and it is not close. The one outsider, Terminal-Lego task_13538, is the pool's only implement-a-chess-engine task and is strongly verified — Terminal-Lego genuinely beats the v1 pool here, as it also does on board-state detection (task_09056) and image comparison (task_14899). TMax has no game content whatsoever; its slate is its read-data-out-of-a-PNG family, which covers the extraction half only, and task_000102_3d7b64bf is the best of them if merge wants TMax representation. TerminalWorld and Recursive-Task-Synthesis have essentially nothing: RTS ranks 2-5 are four rephrasings of one JPEG steganography task and should count as a single item. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench contribute only image-library and pixel-geometry bug fixes; do not promote them.
